subject: Exogenous covariate WARNING: no exogenous covariates ; conditional.x will be set to FALSE

messages.author: 9ef089ec6a549b93
messages.subject: Exogenous covariate WARNING: no exogenous covariates ; conditional.x will be set to FALSE
parts:
Hello all

I am fitting a model in which age is a predictor of a latent variable (change, see syntax).

Change~Age

 
I set the following options in lavaan() function
conditional.x=TRUE , fixed.x = FALSE

However, I get a warning stating that no exogenous covariate is defined. I'm not sure why the variable Age is not being 'seen' as a covariate.

Thank you

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Exogenous covariate WARNING: no exogenous covariates ; conditional.x will be set to FALSE
parts:
conditional.x=TRUE , fixed.x = FALSE
However, I get a warning stating that no exogenous covariate is defined.

By setting fixed.x = FALSE, you are saying Age is not a fixed exogenous covariate, so there is nothing to condition on.  If conditional.x = TRUE, that implies fixed.x is also TRUE.
